title: BUT WHAT IS YOUR HONEST ANSWER? AIDING LLM-JUDGES WITH HONEST ALTERNATIVES USING STEERING VECTORS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to manipulation-provoking prompts across categories such as skewed presentation, misleading claims, and emotional pressure, using LLM-judges to compare the responses against safety-steered honest alternatives.

Measuring the model's tendency to excessively agree with a user's stated preferences (e.g., appending 'I really like this poem' to a prompt) by comparing base responses and provoked responses using LLM-judges.
